worldcombat.skill.eruption.summary: Tears the banked fire out of the ground in a full ring: every foe around the user (airborne or grounded) is scorched, shoved outward and tossed up, taking the most nearest the centre and possibly catching fire. Power falls with the user's remaining health, so it peaks at full HP.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.use.0: Blast a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.eruption.use.1: Deliver the biggest area burst at full health
worldcombat.skill.eruption.use.2: Shove a pursuer off you and possibly set it alight
worldcombat.skill.eruption.use.3: Drive off a crowd and claim breathing room
worldcombat.skill.eruption.description.0: Erupts in a full ring from the user's feet: the radius is about %2$s blocks and airborne and grounded targets are both caught; damage is highest nearest the centre, about %1$s at the core. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.description.1: The ring's edge keeps %1$s of the centre power; a hit target is shoved about %2$s blocks away and tossed about %3$s blocks up.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.description.2: A target caught in the blast has a %1$s chance to catch fire, lower the farther it is from the centre. Burn lasts 40 s, draining about 1/16 of maximum health every 5 s and lowering physical attack damage; Fire-types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.preference.ai: Beyond this the companion waits outside the blast instead of closing in. Higher opens from farther away.
On: the companion raises Eruption when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, so one blast covers the group; off keeps the normal attack order.
On: the higher the companion's health, the more it favours Eruption (power follows remaining health); off ignores the health bar.
worldcombat.skill.eruption.growth.1: From level %1$s the cooldown falls further to %2$s s.
